book.name: YOHAAN
book.title: Gwom ’Borga/ Isi ki Gwo ma YOHAAN mo

content: Gwo Wara’d ki Buŋgwar mo
Ka muŋ’kup̱ tani Gwo diki’d dhali Gwo di’d eya Arumgimis mo dhali Gwo ta’da Arumgimis mo be.
A’di diki’d ’peni ka muŋ’kup̱ nyaḵka Arumgimis mo be.
Aris to ’baar mo ’kokunu mo mmo/uḵ ki a’di mo dhali ton ṯal ’deŋ kamu/ yisa di’da jin uḵu ki dar gi a’di mo.
E a’di mo tani mondiki/e diki’d mo dhali mondiki/e a’di ta moŋkush gi ’kwani mo be.
Dhali moŋkush a’di ’twaḵki mondhurumi’d bwa mo dhali mondhurumi’d diki p̱i a’di e mo be.
Wathi/ diki’d jin ṯu’ckin ma Arumgimis ki yaku/ mo, a’di jin yuḵu gway ka Yohaan mo be.
A’di p̱u’dki’d mo gom gwo mmoṯor mo, mmoṯor gwo mo gom moŋkush mo, ka ris ’kwani ’baar mo mini gam gwo is e a’di mo be.
A’di diki ta moŋkush ki is piti mo. Hili a’di p̱u’dki’d mo mmoṯor gwo gom moŋkush mo be.
Dhali moŋkush gana/ a’di diki’d mmoyayu/ i ’kwaniny’cesh mo be, a’di jin ta moŋkush gana/ mmokusha ris ’kwaniny’ceshi ’baar mo ka ’deṯe/ ’deṯe/ mo be.
A’di diki’d e mony’cesh mo dhali ’kwaniny’cesh uḵkunu ki a’di mo tani hili a’di ’kona ’kwaniny’cesh ki nyiṯẖ mo be.
A’di p̱u’dki’d e kum piti tani dhali ’kwanim piti ’koki bu’th a’di mo be.
Hili aris uni ’baar mo kun bu’thki a’di kun gam gway piti is mo tani a’di c̱iki uni mom’bi’th mo mmowar ki uc̱i ma Arumgimis mo be.
Uni gun dhodhu ’pena bas yisa, walla ’peni bwa gi buŋgwar is yisa, walla ’peni bwa wathi/ yisa, hili ’peni Arumgimis mo be.
Dhali Gwo warki’d ki buŋgwar mo dhali shurki c̱a’b mo e bwam ana mo, ’tu’du/ ka ’the dhali ki gwoŋ gana/ mo. Ana mishkina cam piti mo, monyca gi Ya/ jin di’d ṯal ’de/ ’peni Com mo be.

(Yohaan a’di ṯorki gwo gom a’di mo dhali cuu gwo mo ki: Wathi/ yansan a’di ta jin ṯorka/ um gwo mo ki: A’di jin midi p̱u’du/ i’ko’di aha/ mo tani a’di icaki’d ki aha/ mo haali/ a’di diki’di ṯwa/a/ ki aha/ mo be.)
Dhali ’pena ’tu’d piti mo tani ana ’baar bu’thkina ’the mo mmomara ’the is mo be.
Haali/ gwoŋḵan jin c̱inu mo tani a’di c̱ikunu ka Musa mo. Hili a’the dhali gwoŋ gana/ p̱u’dkin ’pena Yesus Ḵrisṯẖos mo be.
Wathin ṯal ’deŋ kamu/ yisa di’da jin p̱arki’da Arumgimis e ki sule/ sule/ mo be, hili jasi Ya/m pitin ṯal ’de/ a’di jin diki’da bor gi com mo, a’di jin ṯorki a’di eya tente/ mo be.
Gwo jin Ṯor ma Yohaan jin Mii’da Mii ki Yi’de/ mo
Dhali yansan ta gwo jin ṯor ma Yohaan mo ki ’Kwani Yahuuda/ hashki igasiis mo dhali ’Kwani Lawi ’peni Pa Urushaliim mo mmodoṯ a’di gwo mo ki: Ki /e tana ajaye?
A’di ki pi gwo mo. A’di diki ur gwo mo. Hili a’di piki gwo mo mmo/o gwo mo ki: Aha/ dinaki ta Ḵrisṯẖos mo be.

Dhali uni ki doṯ a’di gwo mo ki: Ba /e tana ja sa/? /E tana Iliyya ’taa? A’di ki o gwo mo ki: Aha/ tana a’di yisa. Dhali uni ki o a’di gwo mo ki: I/e tana manc̱i gwo de? Dhali a’di ki thoḵ uni gwo mo ki: Yisa.
Dhali yan’ko’d uni ki o a’di gwo mo ki: Ba ki /e tana jaye? Dhalki aman mina mii tagi gwon thoḵ gom uni gun hashki aman mo. Ata ona /e gwo gom is pini kan mo sa/?

A’di ki o gwo mo ki: Aha/ tana ’twa/ wathin ṯal ’de/ mo mmocuu gwo mo e mombwaasho ki: Kari bway Tap̱a ka ji sho’k mo ma, me’d gwo jin okin ma manc̱i gwo ma Arumgimis kadhamo/ mo jin yuḵu gway ka Ishaya mo.
Dhali uni hashkunu mo ’peni ’Kwani P̱arisiyiin mo be.
Dhali uni doṯki a’di gwo mo ki: Katinta imiikina /e ’kwani ki yi’de/ mo waḵki/ /e diki ta aḴrisṯẖos mo walla Iliyya mo walla amanc̱i gwo mo?
Dhala Yohaan ki thoḵ uni gwo mo ki: Aha/ miikina mii jin miikunu ki yi’de/ mo tani hili wathi/ doshki’di bwam um mo jin molkina um mo be.
Isi a’diyini jin midi yayu/ i’ko’di aha/ mo, dhali wac̱kana p̱p̱am piti mo tani aha/ dinaki ha me’d mo mmo’cuḵ uni mo be.
Mii yansan a’di bu’thki mo mo e Pam Beeṯaniya mo e bwamp̱o/ Yi’deŋ Ḵumma/ Uurdun mo e mo jin miikin ma Yohaana mii ki yi’de/ mo be.
Hili ma, Ari Ḵa’bal ma Arumgimis mo

Dhali ka cim jiŋ ’ko’d mo tani a’di p̱arki’da Yesus e mo mmoyayu/ ’kup̱ kadhoŋ mo i a’di mo dhali o gwo mo ki: Hili mo mo ma, Ari Ḵa’bal ma Arumgimis a’di jin midi ḵal miinthus gi ’kwaniny’cesh mo be.
Wathi/ yansan a’di ta a’di jin ṯorka/ um gwo mo ki: ’Ko’di aha/ tani wathi/ midi p̱u’du/ mo a’di jin caki’d ki aha/ nṯwa/a/ mo haali/ a’di diki’di ṯwa/a/ ki aha/ mo be.
Aha/ ki is pem dinaki mish a’di mo. Hili gom mii yan mo tani aha/ p̱u’dkina mo mmomiiya mii jin miinu ki yi’de/ mo ki a’di minu ṯor eya tente/ e ’Kwani ma Israyiil mo be.
Dhala Yohaan ṯorki gwo mo mmo/o gwo mo ki: Aha/ p̱arkina Shi/in Dheleladhelel e mo mmothulu/ me’d gurko/ ’peni momis mo mmoc̱a’ba p̱o/ a’di mo be.

Aha/ ki is pem dinaki mish a’di mo. Hili a’di jin hashki aha/ mo mmomiiya mii jin miinu ki yi’de/ mo tani a’di o aha/ gwo mo ki: A’di jin mina /e p̱ar Shi/in e mmothulu/ mo dhali c̱a’ba p̱o/ a’di mo tani a’di ta a’di yansan jin mii’da mii jin miinu ki Shi/in Dheleladhelel mo be.
Dhali aha/ mishkina mo mo dhali ta aman/o gwo ki a’di yansan ita Ya/ ma Arumgimis mo be.
Imanciḵ Gwo kun Ṯwa/a/
Dhali ka cim jiŋ ’ko’d mo tani aYohaan a’di doshki’d mo nyaḵki imanciḵ a’di gwo isu/ mo be.
Dhali a’di ki p̱ara Yesus e mo me’d jin yayina a’di mo dhali o gwo mo ki: Hili mo mo ma. A’di ta Ari Ḵa’bal ma Arumgimis mo be.
Dhali imanciḵ a’di gwo su/ ciḵki gwo mo mmo/ona a’di gwo yansan mo dhali uni baṯẖkina Yesus nsho’k mo be.

Yesus ki ṯuka bor mo dhali p̱ar uni e mo mmobaṯẖkina uni a’di nsho’k mo dhali o uni gwo mo ki: Atinta ŋap̱a um mo? Dhali uni ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: Rabbi, (a’di jin ta ’pemen gwo jin onu ka Manṯor Gwo mo) ki /e dini mana mo?

A’di ki thoḵ uni gwo mo ki: Iiyu/ mo ma dhali p̱ar mo e mo. Uni p̱u’dkin mo dhali p̱ar mo e mo jin c̱a’bkina a’di mo dhali uni nyaḵki ’ko ki a’di ka tee c̱aan mo haali/ atente/ ta’da tente/ idoŋon mo be.
Jan ṯal ’de/ ’peni uni su/ jin ciḵ gwo ma Yohaan jin ṯora a’di mo dhali jin baṯẖ a’di nsho’k mo tani a’di ta’da Andaraawus mo, jin ta’da kam ma Simaan Buṯerus mo be.
A’di gamki’da kam piti nṯwa/a/ mo jin ta’da Simaan mo dhali o a’di gwo mo ki: Aman gamkina aMasiyya (jin ta ’pemen gwo jin onu ka Ḵrisṯẖos mo be).

A’di suski’da kam piti eya Yesus mo dhala Yesus p̱arki a’di e mo dhali o a’di gwo mo ki: Hayyiye /e tana Simaan jin ta ya/ ma Yohaan mo. /E minu yuḵ gway ka Sap̱a mo (a’di jin ta ’pemen gwo ka Buṯerus mo).
Yesus Yuḵki’da P̱ilibbus dhala Naṯẖana/iil mo
Dhali ka cim jiŋ ’ko’d mo tani Yesus p̱u’da/ bwa ka pije/ mo mmoya Pany Jaliil mo. Dhali a’di gamki’da P̱ilibbus mo dhali o a’di gwo mo ki: Baṯẖi aha/ nsho’k mo ma.
Dhala P̱ilibbus a’di ta wathi/ gi Pam Beeṯsayda mo jin ta ’peŋkuman bampa/ ma Andaraawus dhala Buṯerus mo be.

Dhala P̱ilibbus a’di gamki’da Naṯẖana/iil mo dhali o a’di gwo mo ki: Aman gamkina wathi/ yin jin okin ma Musa mo e gwoŋḵan jin c̱inu mo dhali imanc̱i gwo ma Arumgimis kadhamo/ mo, uni si’da/ ’kwarki gwo mo goma Yesus gi Pa Naasira mo, a’di jin ta Ya/ ma Yuusup̱ mo.
Dhala Naṯẖana/iil ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: A/mina tom ’boro’da kamu/ piyu/ mo ’peni Pa Naasira mowa? P̱ilibbus ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: Yayu/ mo ma dhali p̱ar e mo.
Dhala Yesus mishki’da Naṯẖana/iil mo mmop̱u’du/ e a’di mo dhali o a’di gwo mo ki: Hili mo mo ma. Wathi/ ’peni ’Kwani ma Israyiil ka jiŋ gana/ jin dar ga maḵ mo.
Dhala Naṯẖana/iil ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: /E mishi aha/ kata moye? Yesus ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: Nṯwa/a/ ka P̱ilibbus diki yuḵ /e mo ki /e dina lamp̱u/ mo tani aha/ p̱arkina /e e mo be.
Dhala Naṯẖana/iil ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: Rabbi, /e ta Ya/ ma Arumgimis mo. /E tana Maliḵ gi ’Kwani ma Israyiil mo be.
Dhala Yesus ki thoḵ a’di gwo mo ki: Haali/ gom gwo jin oka/ /e ki aha/ p̱arkina /e e eya lamp̱u/ mo tani a’di igama /e gwo is mowa? /E mini p̱ar dhan to kun caaca e mo mmobol gwansan e mo.

Dhali a’di ki o a’di gwo mo ki: Ka jiŋ gana/ ka jiŋ gana/ aha/ ṯora /e gwo mo ki um mini p̱ar momis e mo mmodi ki ḵany mo, dhali iman’doyu gwo ma Arumgimis mo mmoseku/ mo dhali mmothulu/ mo ap̱o/ Ya/ gi ’Kwani mo be.
